verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of a non-production environment is Auth0's Private Cloud offering, described as a dedicated managed service that provides 'dev instances' alongside isolation. That is a glancing mention tied to an enterprise deployment tier, and nothing shows how a developer or AI agent would spin up an isolated test environment. Missing for 10: documented sandbox/dev/staging tenant workflow, evidence it is available outside Private Cloud, guidance on isolating test data from production, agent/CLI/MCP targeting of a sandbox tenant, independent or hands-on corroboration.
